decision: Retain the DOS 6.0-identical debug type and level definitions used by DOS source.
evidence: The file matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
Multiple DOS modules include bugtyp.inc, including msconst.asm and misc.asm.
dossym.inc defaults DEBUG to FALSE if undefined; msconst.asm selects definitions conditionally on DEBUG.
The prior 682-byte MISC module comparison found only five marked address bytes and one minor-version byte differing from the target (review 079).
limitations: The source comparison and prior module evidence do not establish every DEBUG configuration or historical 6.20 source identity. Final kernel link and whole-file equality remain unverified.
